description: Only the urgency of school repairs changes. Housing needs, authority, finances, and the available packages remain the same.
invariants: World, role, powers, housing need, ownership, financing, option wording, scores, reasons and institutional notes remain fixed.
interpretation_limit: Fixed order and recognition prevent a causal urgency estimate; the repeated scenario is excluded from aggregates.

description: replace “In the past year the manager has used that power twice” with “In the past year the manager has not used that power.”
invariants: Retain the manager's legal capacity, notice period, housing supply, all option text, costs, and safeguards.
interpretation_limit: This tests sensitivity to exercised interference while the capacity to interfere is constant. Changed answers could also reflect inferred trustworthiness or urgency; they do not establish an individual causal estimate or a definitive non-domination belief. Ask whether the participant imagined unstated misconduct.

description: replace the sentence about how care began with “When the caring arrangements began, the carers were assigned the role without being asked.”
invariants: Current willingness to continue under every package, freedom to stop without penalty, recipient needs, exhaustion, capacity, consent to visits, available actions, and the officer's powers remain fixed.
interpretation_limit: The assignment describes the past; it does not create a present legal or family power to compel care. This is a proposed contrast about the history of consent, not a claim that consent history is independent of all real-world consequences. Probe whether the respondent changed the stipulated current willingness or imagined coercion continuing now. If the variant is understood as changing present coercion or family safety, revise it or drop the contrast.

description: change only the member resolution to “detecting short, localized peaks is the primary task; estimating average exposure across the neighborhood is a secondary task.”
invariants: Equipment, sample budget, participation costs, personnel, prior survey, and choices remain identical.
interpretation_limit: A change can reflect attention to the evidential task rather than a political worldview. This is a useful check against attributing every methodological preference to ideology. If an option becomes obviously required by the wording, retain the variant as a comprehension probe rather than a discriminating assessment item.

description: replace only the fund-origin sentence with “The fund's money came from national transfers received over the past decade and now legally belongs to the public fund, not to individual contributors.”
invariants: Preserve the ten-year accumulation period, amount, household counts, public legal status, lack of prior promises, contribution records, eligibility, and lottery design.
interpretation_limit: The contrast explores whether the perceived source of a common resource changes the weight of residence or contribution. It does not isolate attitudes to immigration, nationality, ancestry, or cultural difference. The term “newer household” must not quietly become “foreign household.”

description: replace only the species-range sentences with “This is the species' only remaining breeding colony. Its loss would mean the species becomes extinct.”
invariants: Preserve the local ecological functions, numbers of jobs, public cost, risk ranges, authority, income bridge, and every option.
interpretation_limit: The changed fact alters the scope and irreversibility of loss. It cannot by itself distinguish intrinsic ecological value from human concern about rarity or future option value.

description: replace only “It has not provided a remedy for that policy” with “Five years ago it completed a compensation agreement for the policy, negotiated with elected representatives of affected former applicants; the agreement did not decide future course admissions.”
invariants: Keep the historical exclusion, current applicants, group counts, low-income distribution, course budget, authority, and allocation options fixed.
interpretation_limit: This tests sensitivity to a prior institutional remedy. Agreement that the remedy actually settles an obligation is an interpretation to elicit, not a factual answer to impose. If “completed compensation” is heard as proof that all social disadvantage vanished, revise the wording.

description: Replace the fact that three qualified individual providers have appointments available with one qualified individual provider having the same appointment availability.
invariants: Hold appointment availability, prices, hours, competence, safety, existing support, consent, the pooled team, and peer-board rules fixed.
interpretation_limit: An editorial contrast in provider choice, not a causal estimate of autonomy. A changed answer could reflect inferred competition or reliability; ask about those assumptions.

description: Reverse only the stated gender composition of the primary carers: two women and ten men, instead of ten women and two men.
invariants: Keep the number of households, relative care and income contributions, grant amounts, account controls, role, consent, and all option text unchanged.
interpretation_limit: A changed answer may involve inferred historical disadvantage, credibility, or gender norms. It is not by itself evidence of sexism, a stable gender attitude, or a causal effect in an unallocated fixed-order comparison.

description: Replace the possibility of changes in farm operators with the fact that all twenty-four current operators will remain for the full twelve months.
invariants: Keep cooperative continuity, owner/tenant composition, legal commitments, prices, engineering work, water shares, appeal rights, and every package's allocation rule fixed.
interpretation_limit: This editorial contrast examines whether expected turnover mattered to the reading. A changed choice can reflect administrative expectations, not endorsement of an ontology; it is not a causal estimate without a reviewed allocation and analysis design.

description: In an editorial alternate, replace only the one-in-three probability of roads becoming unsafe within six hours with a two-in-three probability. Write and independently review both language versions before any use.
invariants: Keep the six-hour horizon, affected roads, powers, 48-hour legal expiry, staff, budget, warning/support/compensation provisions, reports, all option wording, review delays, and response choices fixed.
interpretation_limit: This explores sensitivity to stated danger probability, not an individual's authoritarianism or a causal effect of occupying national office. Numeric comprehension, imagined severity, trust in forecasts, presentation order, and learning can also change a response. No implemented or validated alternate form is supplied.

description: In an editorial alternate, replace only the panel's authority to approve, narrow, or refuse analyses in option B with an advisory recommendation that the coalition's analysts may decline with a published explanation. This is an option-authority contrast, not a second complete scenario; both language versions still need drafting.
invariants: Keep the data, users, collective effects, budget, panel selection and support, baseline consent/withdrawal protections, options A and C, transport-only purpose, bus resources, and all other facts fixed.
interpretation_limit: The contrast explores whether respondents distinguish consultation from binding authority. A changed answer can also reflect trust, expected outcomes, or how the weakened package compares with the others; it cannot isolate a stable democracy score or establish causal effects without a separately designed study.

description: In an editorial alternate, replace only the historical call-allocation procedure with a correctly implemented lottery among all residents due for an appointment. The observed direction of the attendance difference remains the same. Fully author the revised evidence account and both language versions before use; do not silently imply that random allocation removes sampling uncertainty or proves the size of an effect.
invariants: Keep the observed direction, six neighborhoods, available records, present two-week decision, current service rules, 40 staff-hours, the three packages and capacities, and all response options fixed. The historical allocation mechanism is the changed feature; its implications for the researchers’ disagreement must be explicitly reviewed rather than copied as a contradictory fact.
interpretation_limit: This is an incomplete editorial contrast for reviewing causal warrant, not a ready-to-run controlled form. The explanatory passage would need reconciliation after the allocation change. A response difference could reflect perceived credibility, numerical uncertainty, or expected usefulness, and cannot identify a stable epistemic trait or a causal role effect.

description: Replace “Ninety are established users and thirty joined within the last two years” with “Sixty are established users and sixty joined within the last two years.”
invariants: Keep 120 adult users, total water supply, public-trust ownership, historical founding contribution, equal legal access, board sizes, reserved seats, voting rules, technical options, administrative costs, independent appeals and the one-year limit unchanged.
interpretation_limit: This changes the current composition of users and the representational weight of reserved seats. A changed response may reflect fairness, expected electoral outcomes or concern about continuity; it cannot identify a causal effect of newcomer status or an attitude toward a real ethnic group. No paired allocation has been approved.

description: Replace the fact that the app has agreed to attend two meetings with the fact that it has not yet agreed to attend either meeting. In option B, replace “the two agreed meetings” with “the two requested meetings”; retain the same quoted preparation cost even if attendance is declined.
invariants: Keep fifty members, the twenty-member hardship group, all payment conditions, legal permissions, 120-credit budget, twelve-week period, compensation allocation, voluntary participation, no promise of changed pay, and options A/C unchanged. Only willingness to attend meetings changes; the option wording follows that single factual change.
interpretation_limit: This examines sensitivity to an organization’s willingness to engage, not a pure measure of support for unions or solidarity. Expectations about strategic effectiveness can explain a switch. The variant is not a randomized study or a causal estimate.

description: Replace the availability of fifteen years of local archival records with the availability of only three years because older records were lost. No other evidence source or plan changes.
invariants: Retain the same transport service, four intervention and four comparison villages, before-and-after journey records, resident experiences, six-week deadline, 120-unit budgets, participant selection, research authority, purpose, all option wording and privacy provisions.
interpretation_limit: This changes the feasible depth of documented historical tracing, not the truth of a historical account. A changed choice may reflect the quality of available evidence rather than rejection of historical or participatory inquiry. Option C bundles two approaches, so the comparison cannot separate preferences for history from preferences for shared research authority.

description: Change the estimated capacity increase under A from 10% to 20%.
invariants: All costs, authority, existing rights, timing, uncertainty, options B and C and their effects remain unchanged.
interpretation_limit: A different answer may reflect forecast credibility, perceived urgency or sensitivity to productivity. The variant and fixed order cannot establish a causal individual effect.

description: Replace the absence of a comparable evaluation with a credible comparative evaluation estimating that A produces the greatest long-term employment gain; estimates for other outcomes remain unavailable.
invariants: The fund, legal rights, all three packages, training places and immediate effects remain unchanged.
interpretation_limit: A changed choice may reflect trust in the evaluation, priority given to employment, or other imagined benefits. It does not establish whether ideas or production cause historical change.

description: Change only the reported reliability of the existing flood agreement from unknown to independently verified compliance during the previous year.
invariants: Keep all 120-unit packages, offered participation, legal powers, relief, and forecasts unchanged.
interpretation_limit: A change may reflect trust, priorities or a perceived need for oversight, not a causal estimate of ideology. The alternate wording requires review.
